title: Night Moves
heroNote: Bob Seger's 'Night Moves' reached #4 on the Billboard Hot 100 in 1976, becoming a defining track of his career and a staple of 70s rock.

chapters.title: Chart Peak: #4
chapters.body: The song peaked at #4 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 21 weeks on the chart.

chapters.title: Autobiographical Lyrics
chapters.body: The song's lyrics are largely autobiographical, reflecting Seger's personal experiences and struggles.
sourceMaterial: Still Showing Up in Pop Culture

chapters.title: Album: Night Moves
chapters.body: Released in 1976, the 'Night Moves' album features Seger's signature rock sound and includes the hit single of the same name.

chapters.title: Chart Neighbors
